_comment: Single source of truth for buyer testimonials on CongoAfricanGreys.com. Names and locations come from the breeder ONLY (Mark & Teri Benjamin ruled 2026-09-09); never infer a name from a photo filename or a sibling page. q1-q3 quotes are verbatim from the live homepage; q4 is Archie O'Brien's real review, verbatim from the breeder. `remap` lists the historical mis-attributions scripts/sweep_review_attribution.py rewrites: match on (name, quote prefix) -> replace with the target review. Gate: tests/test_review_attribution.py. Sweep: scripts/sweep_review_attribution.py --check.

reviews.quote: I searched for African Grey parrots for sale near me for months before finding C.A.Gs. Their birds are truly top-notch! My African Grey is affectionate, intelligent, and already picking up words. The shipping process was seamless, and they included a health guarantee.
reviews.name: Clifford Hutter

reviews.quote: At first I was hesitant about buying a bird online, but C.A.Gs made the process stress-free. They provided detailed care instructions and my parrot arrived in perfect condition. My Congo African Grey is now the star of our family, talking and entertaining us daily.
reviews.name: Richard Woodard

reviews.quote: I ordered a Congo African Grey from C.A.Gs and the experience was flawless. My parrot is healthy, friendly, and well-trained. Watching it grow and bond with my family has been an absolute joy. I recommend C.A.Gs to anyone looking for a quality African Grey.
reviews.name: Catherine Kempf

reviews.quote: Finding a healthy and well-socialized female Congo African Grey was important to me, and I'm so glad I chose C.A.Gs. I highly recommend C.A.Gs to anyone looking for a quality Congo Grey parrot.
